title: Interface
description: A boundary a flow passes through: an API request or response, a Kafka topic, an event or a file. See docs/flows.md.

kind.description: What kind of boundary this is.

owner.description: The team that owns this interface.

status.description: existing: already in production, so missing fields become change requests to the owner. proposed: being designed in this flow.

version.description: The interface's own version, free text.

imported.description: The schema file this was imported from. Re-import to refresh the fields.

field.description: Fields. Nested fields use dotted names, e.g. customer.id.

required.description: Whether the field is always present.
